BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to cigarette taxes; adding a new section to chapter82.24 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) There is hereby levied and there shall be collected as providedby this chapter, an additional tax upon the sale, use, consumption,handling, possession, or distribution of cigarettes in an amount equalto the rate of fiftythree and seventyfive onehundredths mills percigarette. (2) The money collected under this section during any month shallbe deposited by the twentyfifth day of the following month as follows: (a) 83.26 percent into the health services account created in RCW43.72.900; and (b) The remainder into the youth tobacco prevention account createdin RCW 70.155.120.
